key_insight: Continuous Lie point-symmetry generators can be recovered directly from sampled differential-equation data without symbolic determining equations or closed-form governing equations.
engineering_relevance: Explicit symmetry generators can reveal geometric structure useful for model reduction and scientific machine learning.
method: Construct a sampled determining operator on jet-space data using prolongation.
Apply sequential subspace restrictions to separate intrinsic generators from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions.
Fit a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients, with a rank-stabilization preflight test under dictionary refinement.
evidence_signal: On a controlled benchmark with a known 11-dimensional represented intrinsic symmetry algebra, the method recovers all represented generators, reproduces Lie brackets to numerical precision, and approximates one known generator beyond the training domain.
watch_item: Recovery is limited by the chosen dictionary's representational capacity; the preflight test checks whether the represented algebra stabilizes under refinement.
paper_title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
